# jumpcloud_application_association (Resource)

Associates a JumpCloud application with a user or user group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grant a user group access to an application.
resource "jumpcloud_application_association" "finance_team" {
  application_id = jumpcloud_application.finance.id
  target_type    = "user_group"
  target_id      = jumpcloud_user_group.finance.id
}

# Grant a single user access to an application.
resource "jumpcloud_application_association" "contractor" {
  application_id = jumpcloud_application.finance.id
  target_type    = "user"
  target_id      = "64a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application.
- `target_id` (String) The ID of the target user or user group.
- `target_type` (String) The type of target: user or user_group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format application_id/target_type/target_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_application_association.example <application-id>/<target-type>/<target-id>
```
